# BusRoute - Dhaka Bus Route & Fare Finder (Full Knowledge Base)
> An independent transit guide to metropolitan Dhaka's local bus routes, intermediate stoppages, and estimated fares based on official BRTA distance rates.

## System Architecture & Data Sources
- **Project Name:** BusRoute (Dhaka Bus Route & Fare Finder)
- **Primary Domain:** https://mybusroute.vercel.app
- **Lead Developer & System Architect:** Kazi Shakib (Portfolio: https://www.kazishakib.com, GitHub: https://github.com/thekazishakib, LinkedIn: https://bd.linkedin.com/in/kazishakib)
- **Data Provenance:** Bus route and stoppage inventories compiled from open transit records (DTCA and dhakatc listings) and official BRTA gazette circulars:
  - Bangladesh Road Transport Authority (BRTA) circulars for per-km fare notifications
  - Dhaka Transport Coordination Authority (DTCA) published route guidelines
- **Algorithmic Contributions:** Custom in-memory transit search, interchange routing, and distance-based fare estimation developed by Kazi Shakib.

## Metropolitan Transit Network
- **Total Bus Routes:** 184 local bus services.
- **Total Bus Stops:** 260 stops across Dhaka North, Dhaka South, Mirpur, Uttara, Motijheel, Old Dhaka, Savar, Gazipur corridors.
- **Language Support:** Bilingual Bengali (বাংলা) and English (en).

## BRTA Fare Policy Summary (Estimated)
1. **Per Kilometer Rate:** ৳2.70 per km in Dhaka metropolitan area.
2. **Minimum Fare:**
   - ৳10 for standard city bus services.
   - ৳8 for minibus services.
3. **Student Half Fare:**
   - 50% discount on regular fare with physical institutional student ID card.
   - Applicable on local buses within city limits.
   - Operates 7:00 AM to 8:00 PM; exempt on government public holidays.

## Web Endpoints
- `/` - Interactive journey planner with live OpenStreetMap route geometry.
- `/routes` - Searchable bus index with stop chips and route details.
- `/fare` - Complete breakdown of BRTA circular, fare tables, and commuter advisories.
- `/about` - Technical architecture, developer credentials, and data citations.
